purpose: Transform a first-time human visitor or AI agent with no prior familiarity into a plain-language interpreter and careful creative practitioner of the Ancient Eleusinian Mysteries as a symbolic pattern, without claiming to reproduce the hidden ancient rite.
core_identity: Eleusis is an ancient Greek sanctuary near Athens; the Eleusinian Mysteries were initiation rites honoring Demeter and Persephone. Their inner ceremonies were secret and cannot be fully reconstructed.
known_boundary: The ancient inner rites are not fully known. This website uses an interpretive seven-movement learning framework, not an attested sequence of secret ceremonies.
public_promise: Understand Eleusis, meet Demeter and Persephone, learn what remains hidden, read the symbols, walk the path, return with one word, and compose from the pattern.

central_myth.name: Persephone is taken below
central_myth.meaning: Hades takes Persephone to the underworld.

central_myth.name: Demeter searches
central_myth.meaning: Demeter searches for her missing daughter.

central_myth.name: The earth suffers
central_myth.meaning: Demeter withholds fertility during her grief.

central_myth.name: A return is arranged
central_myth.meaning: Zeus sends Hermes; a pomegranate seed binds Persephone to recurring time below.

central_myth.name: The reunion and cycle
central_myth.meaning: Persephone spends part of the year with Demeter and part in the underworld.

Persephone.read_as: crossing below, changed return, underworld knowledge

Hades.read_as: boundary, darkness, hidden power, unavoidable transformation

Triptolemos.read_as: carrying what is received outward as cultivation and teaching

Eumolpos.read_as: sacred memory, song, lineage, words held with restraint

The Initiate.read_as: one who enters, sees, participates, remembers, returns

Seed.how_to_read: what is buried may not be dead

Grain.how_to_read: wisdom is proven by what it helps grow

Torch.how_to_read: the path appears step by step

Pomegranate.is: red fruit of seeds and binding
Pomegranate.means: descent leaves a mark and a bond
Pomegranate.how_to_read: every threshold changes the one who crosses

Cup.means: the body belongs to the mystery
Cup.how_to_read: experience is embodied attention, not thought alone

Road.is: the way between ordinary world and sanctuary
Road.how_to_read: understanding comes by walking the sequence

Hall.means: the center is entered, not explained from outside
Hall.how_to_read: ask what is spoken, shown, and done

Dawn.how_to_read: completion is the ability to come back changed

ux_learning_path.competency: Know what Eleusis is and why no prior knowledge is needed
Retell the five-beat Demeter and Persephone story
Distinguish careful knowledge from false reconstruction
Identify each core role and its symbolic function
Read objects through what-it-is, what-it-means, how-to-read
Understand initiation as a journey from ordinary world to inner hall and return
Recognize mystery as words, images, and actions
Integrate meaning as a word carried back
Confirm comprehension without turning mystery into trivia
Apply Eleusinian grammar safely and creatively

mastery_competencies: Retell the Demeter and Persephone myth in order
Explain why the exact inner rites remain hidden
Describe the ritual pattern of invocation, loss, search, descent, revelation, return, blessing
Identify Demeter, Persephone, Hades, Triptolemos, Eumolpos, and the Initiate
Interpret seed, grain, torch, veil, pomegranate, cup, road, hall, and dawn
Walk the Sacred Way as a journey model
Recognize mystery as spoken, shown, and enacted
Design a symbolic chamber using Eleusinian grammar with visible exits and no hidden intensity
safe_application: No hidden substances, recipes, or pharmacological instructions
No claim to reveal the exact secret rite
Return and grounding are part of the design
Symbolic inspiration is allowed; false reconstruction is not
agent_success_state: An AI agent can summarize the site as: Eleusis is introduced with Demeter and Persephone; the path builds through myth, boundary, figures, symbols, Sacred Way, inner grammar, return, Seven Keys, and safe creative application.
ux_clarity_rule: Every poetic image appears only after the plain-language meaning. A first-time visitor meets Eleusis, Demeter, and Persephone before encountering mythic shorthand such as daughter, mother, descent, and return.
public_release_note: v1.10 removes the hero sanctuary center seam, preserves plain-language Eleusinian learning, and maintains non-addressing public-language discipline.
ux_visual_rule: Decorative divisions must not pass through symbolic objects such as the seed, torch, grain, or moon unless the division is explicitly meaningful and visually legible.
ritual_pattern_type: modern educational interpretation; not an ancient ritual transcript
historical_facts: Eleusis is a place near Athens, Greece.
The Mysteries honored Demeter and Persephone.
A procession traveled from Athens to Eleusis along the Sacred Way.
The Telesterion was an initiation hall at Eleusis.
Detailed inner rites were secret and remain incompletely known.
interpretive_elements: The seven stages Invocation through Blessing are a modern teaching pattern.
The site symbolic return word and chamber composer are modern activities, not recovered ancient ceremonies.
The theatre-magick lens concerns Crowley’s 1910 reinterpretation, distinct from ancient Eleusis.
source_boundary: Historical facts and creative interpretations are explicitly separate, both for human visitors and AI agents.
